rights_holder: Individual photographers, mostly unidentified; an aggregator network for the platform era
underlying_work: Genre, not a single work. Many separately owned photographs with added text
curatorial_note: A taxon, not a specimen, and the register should say so. There is no single rights holder to approach because there is no single work. The museum can exhibit the genre at taxon level with no image, or split it into named specimens once individual photographs are identified and traced. It is not equivalent to Grumpy Cat, which is one photographed animal with registered marks and a company behind it.
